sentences.en: Optimization usually lives in flat space.
sentences.zh: 优化通常发生在平坦的空间里。
但许多真实问题并非如此。

sentences.en: The orientation of a robot arm.
The path of a drone that must close its loop.
sentences.zh: 必须闭合回环的无人机航迹。

sentences.en: The weights of a neural network, kept orthogonal.
sentences.zh: 保持正交的神经网络权重。
在双曲空间中展开的层级结构。

sentences.en: Brain scans made of tiny ellipsoids.
sentences.zh: 由无数小椭球构成的脑部扫描。
隐藏在数据中的子空间。

sentences.en: They all live on manifolds: spaces that curve as a whole, yet look flat up close.
sentences.zh: 它们都生活在流形上：整体弯曲、近看却平坦的空间。

sentences.en: To optimize there, every familiar idea must be rebuilt: direction, distance, gradient, step.
sentences.zh: 要在那里做优化，每个熟悉的概念都必须重建：方向、距离、梯度、步长。

sentences.en: This series builds that geometry from the ground up, with full proofs, and pictures that show why every assumption matters.
sentences.zh: 这个系列从零开始建立这套几何：完整的证明，以及说明每个假设为何重要的画面。
